description: '''Thai rock''' ({{langx|th|ไทยร็อก}}) is [[rock music]] from [[Thailand]] that was heavily influenced by [[American rock|American]] and [[British rock]] bands. It originally emerged in the 1960s, when Thai musicians played cover songs for American soldiers stationed there during the [[Vietnam War]]. The genre later flourished in the 1980s with bands like [[Asanee–Wasan]], [[Carabao (band)|Carabao]], and [[Micro (Thai band)|Micro]]. Today, Thai rock has become as diverse as the broader rock genre itself. Bands adopting this style are further classified under more specific subgenres or combinations, including [[alternative rock]], [[grunge]], [[folk rock]], [[new wave music|new wave]], [[pop rock]], [[punk rock]], [[heavy metal music|heavy metal]], and more recently, [[indie music|indie]], [[post-rock]], and [[shoegaze]]. Because these subgenres all fall under the broad umbrella of rock, Thai rock can be more specifically defined as rock music infused with Thai cultural sensibilities.
